include: Hidden and locked layers, and anything inside hidden or locked containers, are not snap targets.
Snapped positions are stored exactly as computed; only displayed values are rounded.
The snap distance is in screen pixels and is converted to document units with the zoom.
A snapped drag is still one history entry: its moves share the drag's gesture id.
The layers being dragged, and everything inside them, are not snap targets.
avoid: Snapping to hidden or locked layers.
Rounding the stored position to whole pixels or to display precision as part of snapping.
